{{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox NCAA team season |CoachRank= |APRank= |mode=Basketball |year=2016–17 |team=Northern Colorado Bears |image=UNC Bears.png |conference=Big Sky Conference |division= |short_conf= Big Sky |record=11–18 |conf_record=7–11 |head_coach=[[Jeff Linder]] |hc_year = 1st |asst_coach1=Steve Smiley |asst_coach2=Ken DeWeese |asst_coach3=Vinnie McGhee |stadium=[[Bank of Colorado Arena]] |champion= |bowl= |bowl_result= }} {{2016–17 Big Sky men's basketball standings}} The '''2016–17 Northern Colorado Bears men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Northern Colorado]] during the [[2016–17 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Bears were led by first-year head coach [[Jeff Linder]] and played their home games at [[Bank of Colorado Arena]] in [[Greeley, Colorado]]. They were members of the [[Big Sky Conference]]. They finished the season 11–18, 7–11 in Big Sky play to finish in a tie for eighth place. On October 8, 2016, the school self-imposed a postseason ban amid an ongoing NCAA investigation.{{Cite web|url=http://www.denverpost.com/2016/10/08/northern-colorado-basketball-penalties/|title=University of Northern Colorado imposed penalties on itself over NCAA violations|agency=Associated Press|access-date=2017-01-12}} ==Previous season== The [[2015–16 Northern Colorado Bears men's basketball team|Bears]] finished the [[2015–16 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2015–16 season]] 10–21, 7–11 in Big Sky play to finish in ninth place. They lost to [[2015–16 Portland State Vikings men's basketball team|Portland State]] in the first round of the [[2016 Big Sky Conference men's basketball tournament|Big Sky tournament]]. On April 21, 2016, the school fired head coach [[B. J. Hill (basketball)|B. J. Hill]] amid an NCAA investigation into "serious and concerning" allegations of violations within the program.{{Cite web|url=http://www.denverpost.com/2016/04/21/northern-colorado-fires-mens-basketball-coach-b-j-hill/|title=Northern Colorado fires men's basketball coach B.J. Hill – The Denver Post|access-date=2017-01-12}} On May 1, the school hired Jeff Linder as head coach.{{Cite web|url=http://uncbears.com/news/2016/5/1/mens-basketball-jeff-linder-named-new-unco-mbb-head-coach.aspx|title=Jeff Linder Named New @unco_mbb Head Coach|website=University of Northern Colorado|access-date=2017-01-12}} ==Departures== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
